tags.LYRICS:
[Verse]
This one's on me, let me buy you a house
Let me buy you a car, I'll give you everything you want
Let me take you to the beach, gotta get you on payroll
Always gotta be around you, always gotta have control
Wait!

This one's on me, let me buy you some roses
Let me buy you a ring, let me buy you a pony
Introduce you to my parents while I get you on payroll
Kneeling down on one knee, cause you won't give up control

[Instrumental]

[Chorus]
This next round is always on, Mr Lovebomb
The way he drinks, Billy won't buy you any more
Mistakes are mistakes but you owe him now
And it will always be your fault

[Verse]
This one's on me, I'll give you a safe space
I'll make you feel love, then slowly take it all away
You don't need a job, it's making you unwell
But you can come live with me, and I'll make it all better


This one's on you, 'cause you're out with your friends
After everything I've done, you're fucking ungrateful
Oh, don't you say you're scared, stop fucking internalising
You're lucky I love you, if you leave you'll have nothing

[Chorus]
This next round is always on, Mr Lovebomb
The way he drinks, Billy won't buy you any more
Mistakes are mistakes but you owe him now
And it will always be your fault

This next round is on, Mr Lovebomb (Mr Lovebomb)
The way he drinks, Billy won't buy you any more
You owe him now, and it will always be your fault

This next round is on, Mr Lovebomb (Mr Lovebomb)
The way he drinks, Billy won't buy you any more
'Cause you owe him now, it will always be your fault
